# dsh-cost-pill
**English** · 简体中文

Continues the DSH composer's own token-usage pill with what the session has cost so
far in yuan — th

e amount is written inside that pill, so it inherits the host's
spacing and reads as part of the sam

nt is written inside that pill, so it inherits the host's
spacing and reads as part of the same row.

*In the desktop app: the cost continues the composer pill row, after the token
usage and cache-hit r

esktop app: the cost continues the composer pill row, after the token
usage and cache-hit readings.*
*Rendered from this repository's own `lib/client.js` with sample usage data.*

> **What the install includes.** The plugin gives you the composer pill and the
> priced usage dialo

gs. The per-turn cost row under each answer — the third
> screenshot on the listing — is **not** par

t of the install: it needs a small
> host patch. Follow Per-turn cost.
## What it shows

`· 费用 ¥0.0871` — the estimated cost of every token this session has billed so far.
Hovering the pill
reveals the breakdown the number is made of:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The pill disappears while the session has billed no tokens yet.
## The usage dialogs

The host's own token-usage dialogs show counts but no money. While one is open,
each bucket row gain

s its own amount and the list closes with the estimated total,
the rate window in force, and a one-l
ine note — the same figures the pill shows.
## Per-turn cost (optional — installed separately)

The row under each answer — `用量 6.2M tok · 费用 ¥0.1718` — is rendered by the host
from per-turn billi

ng buckets that are not exposed to plugins, so **this plugin
cannot add that row**. The repository s

hips the procedure in two forms; install
either one on top of the plugin.
### Option A — install the skill (recommended)

1. Copy `per-turn/SKILL.md` to
`~/.dsh/skills/dsh-per-turn-cost/SKILL.md`
(`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skill

s\dsh-per-turn-cost\SKILL.md` on Windows).
2. Restart DSH so the skill catalog reloads.
3. In any co
nversation, ask: `用 dsh-per-turn-cost 给每轮加上费用`.
### Option B — paste the prompt

Open `per-turn/PROMPT.md`, copy the fenced block, and send it
in a normal conversation. The agent do
es the same work without needing the skill.
### What either route changes

It edits the host's own bundled `dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js` — inside
`node_modules` for an np

m/dsh web install, inside `app.asar` for the desktop app,
which must be closed first. The agent back

s the file up, syntax-checks the result,
and tells you the restore command.

A DSH update replaces that file, so the row has to be added again afterwards.
That is precisely why

it cannot ship as a plugin: shipping it would mean writing
into the host's own code on every user's

t ship as a plugin: shipping it would mean writing
into the host's own code on every user's machine.
## Prices
Official DeepSeek list prices, yuan per 1M tokens:
| Model | Cache hit (peak / off-peak) | Cache miss (peak / off-peak) | Output (peak / off-peak) |

- Peak is Beijing time 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, Monday to Friday; everything
else is off-peak. T

he check runs on the Beijing clock, so the figure does not
depend on the browser's time zone.
- The

retired ids `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` are billed
at the `deepseek-flash

` rate, which is what DeepSeek's own sheet says happens to
requests still naming them.
- Cache-write

tokens have no published rate; they are billed at the cache-miss rate.
- A session whose model id t

his plugin does not recognise is priced as
`deepseek-flash`, and the breakdown says so.
## Install
From the repo (works today):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From npm, once published:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> The npm package is `dsh-cost-pill-cny`, not `dsh-cost-pill`: the shorter name
> already belongs to

an unrelated plugin, and installing that one would give you
> a different feature set.
Or from a local checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then reload the page. No restart is needed on hosts that hot-apply profile patches.
## Scope and limits

- The pill is an **estimate for display only**; billing stays whatever the
provider charges.
- It pr

ices the whole session with the session's current model. DeepSeek bills per
request, so a session th

at switched models mid-way can be off by the rate
difference between them.
- It reads the `tokenUsag

e` and `modelSelection` session projections for the pill,
and appends amounts to the host's own usag

e dialogs by reading the counts those
dialogs already render. It never replaces a host component, an

d if that markup
does not look the way it expects, it leaves the dialog exactly as it found it.
- No
telemetry, no network calls, no files written.
